verdict.rationale: The evidence shows two-way Slack use: you can manage incidents from Slack (docs-2) and start post-incident reviews from it (docs-62, docs-23). It also claims 750+ integrations (docs-50), with REST API, Events API and v3 webhooks plus incident workflows as the plumbing for two-way sync (docs-32, docs-31, docs-33, docs-53, docs-22). GitHub appears only as a read-only code source for the SRE Agent (docs-56), and the Scribe Agent joins generic conference bridges (docs-63). Missing for 10: any evidence of Jira, Microsoft Teams or Zoom integrations, documented two-way state sync with GitHub and Jira, and independent hands-on corroboration.
